description: This script generates a comprehensive API index documentation in MDX format from an OpenAPI JSON spec and a sidebar configuration. It organizes API endpoints by tags and categories, and produces a structured documentation page.

methods.name: buildSlugMap
methods.description: Builds a map from sidebar labels to API doc slugs by reading the sidebar.js file.

methods.name: slugify
methods.description: Converts a string into a URL-friendly slug.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that reads the OpenAPI spec, organizes endpoints by tags and categories, and generates the MDX documentation file.
